name: Whisperer
summary:
“I don’t know how to tell you this, friend, but it seems like you’re a ghost. Not ideal, I know.” 

So begins Whisperer, a puzzle game where you play as a ghost who can only interact with the world using your voice. The story unfolds over three chapters where you meet Bea, Harold, and a cast of plants around the greenhouse. Bea is in a bit of a rut, and it’s your job to help Bea and her plants thrive.
